name: Redis State Tool
description: Redis-backed shared runtime state and stream tools for QwenPaw agents
author: Felix MA

tools.name: redis_state_set
tools.description: Store JSON-serializable temporary runtime state in Redis with TTL. Configure Redis here once; every redis_state_* and redis_stream_* tool shares this configuration.

config_fields.name: redis_url
config_fields.label: Redis URL
config_fields.help: Shared Redis connection URL used by all Redis State tools.

config_fields.name: key_prefix
config_fields.label: Redis Key Prefix
config_fields.help: Prefix for keys created by this plugin, for example qwenpaw:runtime:...

config_fields.name: default_ttl_seconds
config_fields.label: Default TTL Seconds
config_fields.help: Default TTL used by redis_state_set when ttl_seconds is omitted.

config_fields.name: max_ttl_seconds
config_fields.label: Max TTL Seconds
config_fields.help: Upper bound for ttl_seconds, used to avoid accidental long-lived temporary state.

config_fields.name: max_value_bytes
config_fields.label: Max Value Bytes
config_fields.help: Maximum serialized JSON payload size accepted by redis_state_set.

tools.name: redis_state_get
tools.description: Read temporary runtime state from Redis by key. Sensitive fields are masked by default. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_state_delete
tools.description: Delete temporary runtime state from Redis by key. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_state_exists
tools.description: Check whether a temporary runtime state key exists in Redis. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_state_ttl
tools.description: Get remaining TTL for a temporary runtime state key. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_add
tools.description: Append an event object to a Redis Stream for async workflows or agent handoff. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_read
tools.description: Read recent events from a Redis Stream without consumer groups. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_group_create
tools.description: Create a Redis Stream consumer group, optionally creating the stream if it does not exist. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_read_group
tools.description: Read Redis Stream events as a consumer-group consumer for reliable async processing. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_ack
tools.description: Acknowledge one or more Redis Stream message IDs in a consumer group. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.
